ranking_rule.within_cohort: For each metric, (mean reference - mean method) / max(abs(mean reference), normalization_floor), averaging the six prescribed cohort decisions before division.
ranking_rule.primary: Descending equal-weight average over the four cohorts and four normalized native loss metrics.
ties: Ascending cohort-macro mean released moved fraction
Ascending cohort-macro mean complete decision CPU
ranking_rule.reporting: Report every configuration, every cohort and native metric, admission, released movement, proposal/Selection/Audit/complete timing and overshoot. All outcomes include rejected-action incumbent fallbacks; there are no significance claims.
